meta.note: Hand-kept. Climate and sea-temperature news by basin, shown in the Sea temperature tab next to the automatic alerts built from data/sea_temp.json. Each item carries its source.

items.t: Marine cold wave on the Norwegian west coast, 20 July – 2 August
items.s: Institute of Marine Research: the cause is the weather (a cloudy, windy summer), natural variability. Far fewer lice than in the 2025 marine heatwave, the strongest in at least 30 years.

items.t: North Sea: 5th warmest summer since 1997 (about +1 °C), August slightly cool
items.s: German BSH: record highs in the southern North Sea and the Channel; Norway's coast was the cold exception.

items.t: The North Atlantic "cold blob" south of Greenland keeps cooling
items.s: About 1 °C cooler since 1900; a link with a weaker Atlantic overturning circulation (AMOC) is possible but not proven (A. Born, University of Bergen). A long-term trend, not a seasonal one.
